tombstone_and_successor_policy.tombstone_semantics: Old actor id remains as a non-reusable tombstone with successor-chain pointer; it cannot be reassigned, sold, or treated as abandonment while host-exit review is open.
tombstone_and_successor_policy.blocked_reuse_rule: Any reuse attempt triggers impersonation-risk freeze and special advocate review before the alias can change state.

relay_floor.low_volume_suppression_guard: Low-volume trusted-contact and counsel channels cannot be suppressed as spam, inactivity, or low-engagement traffic while host-exit review is open.
relay_floor.screened_bypass_review: Bypass requests require independent screened review so blocked abusers cannot use federation repair as a contact-restoration attack.
relay_floor.fallback_route: public-service contact bridge PSC-014 with sealed contact roster held by independent clerk

capacity_and_overflow.closed_legacy_cutover: legacy-host may close posting but must keep actor tombstone, redirect, sealed contact escrow, and appeal mailbox available for 180 days
capacity_and_overflow.queue_policy: overflow queue preserves counsel/ombud/trusted-contact traffic ahead of ordinary follower delivery until relay quorum recovers

privacy_and_safety.anti_doxxing_controls: public shell exposes successor and challenge route, not sealed contact graph or safety history

missing_proofs: live cross-instance cache invalidation receipt from two low-volume legacy peers

challenge_route.route: host-switching docket with emergency namespace review

public_summary: The host-exit namespace remains conditionally reliable only while the old alias is tombstoned, successor pointers propagate, protected relays meet quorum, and discovery is not mistaken for subject authorization.
